mechanism: Zoledronic acid can cause severe diarrhea as an adverse effect, and concurrent loperamide use may mask GI symptoms or lead to constipation-related complications; additionally, both drugs can affect electrolyte balance and renal function.
action: Monitor for GI adverse effects closely; use loperamide cautiously and only if diarrhea occurs after zoledronic acid administration; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte monitoring.
